declared_dirs.summary: Design inputs: sources, tokens, specs and exports.
declared_dirs.why: Keeps design material in one tree, apart from code.

declared_dirs.summary: Handed-over design files, no code.
declared_dirs.why: Keeps original design files apart from code; tracked with Git LFS by .gitattributes.

declared_dirs.summary: Design tokens: the one source of truth for colour, type, space.
declared_dirs.why: One place to change the look; src/styles imports these and never redefines them.

declared_dirs.summary: Written specs and notes.
declared_dirs.why: Design intent lives next to the tokens, not in code comments.

declared_dirs.summary: Images exported from design tools.
declared_dirs.why: Separates tool exports from images the pages import; tracked with Git LFS.

declared_dirs.summary: Files served as-is, such as favicon.svg and robots.txt; folder README.md and .gitkeep files are not published.
declared_dirs.why: Vite copies this folder unchanged into the build (publicDir).

declared_dirs.summary: Self-hosted fonts only (may be empty; keep a .gitkeep).
declared_dirs.why: Fonts must be local because no remote URL may load at runtime.

declared_dirs.summary: Site source: pages, components, styles, assets and helpers.
declared_dirs.why: The Vite build reads the site only from here.

declared_dirs.summary: The HTML pages.
declared_dirs.why: This is the Vite root; each HTML file here becomes a page.

declared_dirs.summary: Reusable page parts: HTML partials, the script entry site.ts, and component TypeScript.
declared_dirs.why: Pages pull shared partials in with <!-- include: name.html --> at build time.

declared_dirs.summary: Stylesheets (import the tokens; never redefine them).
declared_dirs.why: One place for CSS; it must not redefine tokens.

declared_dirs.summary: Images the pages import.
declared_dirs.why: Imported images are hashed and checked by the build.

declared_dirs.summary: Small shared TypeScript helpers, including the contrast pair list and the CSS rule reader the tests use.
declared_dirs.why: Plain logic that unit tests can cover without a browser.

declared_dirs.summary: Tests: unit tests and optional browser tests.
declared_dirs.why: Keeps tests out of src; each runner reads its own sub-folder.

declared_dirs.summary: Unit tests named *.test.ts or *.spec.ts.
declared_dirs.why: vite.config.ts test.include discovers tests only here.

declared_dirs.summary: Optional browser tests named *.e2e.ts.
declared_dirs.why: playwright.config.ts testMatch; run by pnpm xtask e2e, not by pnpm xtask ci.

declared_dirs.summary: Helper scripts, such as check-contrast.ts.
declared_dirs.why: Keeps one-off tools out of src and out of the check runner; pnpm contrast runs check-contrast.ts.

declared_dirs.summary: Project docs (not README), such as the accessibility and check guides.
declared_dirs.why: Gives loose Markdown one home instead of the project root.

declared_dirs.summary: Project tooling; holds the check runner in tools/xtask.
declared_dirs.why: Keeps the check runner apart from site code.

declared_dirs.summary: The check runner: main.ts, dist-check.ts, site-plugins.ts.
declared_dirs.why: pnpm xtask runs tools/xtask/main.ts; it is locked.

placement_rules.reason: Loose Markdown notes go in docs/; README, LICENSE, CHANGELOG and other governance files stay
Vitest finds tests only in tests/unit/ (test.include in vite.config.ts); *.e2e.ts never moves
